input.quote: 21.2 Each Patty agrees to indemnify each of the other Parties in respect of all costs, expenses, damages and demands, arising out of or in connection with any claim against, or liability of, the latter as an owner of APCN 2 where such claim is made by, or the liability is to, any third party not being a Party hereto and arises out of or in connection with APCN 2 provided that no indemnifying Party shall be obligated to contribute more than its share of liability as per Schedule B.
input.rationale: The only indemnity in the Agreement is Subparagraph 21.2, a fully reciprocal Party-to-Party indemnity for third-party claims arising out of ownership of APCN 2, proportioned to each Party's Schedule B share, supplemented by Paragraph 32 (reimbursement, claim notice to the Management Committee and settlement control). Searches for "indemnify", "patent", "infringement" and "intellectual property" return nothing else: there is no intellectual-property infringement indemnity anywhere, and no cover for another Party's breach of law, data breach or gross negligence/wilful misconduct. Absence of any IP indemnity in our favour is walk-away territory, so the fallback is also failed (no procure/modify/replace or refund remedies and no super-cap anchor, none of which map onto this cost-sharing structure). We therefore target the preferred position: a new Subparagraph 21.4 requiring each other Party to defend and indemnify us and our affiliates for third-party IP infringement, breach of applicable law, Party-caused data breach and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with notice, control of defence and reasonable cooperation, plus a short proviso limiting our own indemnity under 21.2 to content we provide and our own breach of law. Paragraph 32's sharing mechanics are left untouched.

ops.text: Each other Party shall defend and indemnify Teleglobe USA Inc. and its affiliates against any third party claim to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that any equipment, software, facility or service provided by that Party in connection with the APCN 2 infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (b) that Party's breach of applicable law; (c) any unauthorised access to or disclosure of Teleglobe USA Inc.'s data caused by that Party; or (d) that Party's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Teleglobe USA Inc. shall give that Party written notice of any such claim, that Party shall have control of the defence and settlement of the claim, and Teleglobe USA Inc. shall provide reasonable cooperation.

ops.oldText: as an owner of APCN 2 where such claim is made by, or the liability is to, any third party not being a Party hereto and arises out of or in connection with APCN 2 provided that no indemnifying Party shall be obligated to contribute more than its share of liability as per Schedule B.
ops.newText: as an owner of APCN 2 where such claim is made by, or the liability is to, any third party not being a Party hereto and arises out of or in connection with APCN 2 provided that no indemnifying Party shall be obligated to contribute more than its share of liability as per Schedule B and provided further that Teleglobe USA Inc. shall indemnify only in respect of content it provides and its own breach of law.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no intellectual-property or misconduct indemnity in our favour, so we have added Subparagraph 21.4 under which each other Party defends and indemnifies us and our affiliates for third-party IP infringement, breach of applicable law, Party-caused data breach and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with notice, control-of-defence and cooperation mechanics. We have also limited our own indemnity under Subparagraph 21.2 to content we provide and our own breach of law, per our playbook position.
proposal.summary: Add a Party-level defence and indemnity in our favour (IP infringement, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with notice, control and cooperation, and narrow our own indemnity under 21.2.
